model_assumptions.energy: Linear distance/range vehicle SOC; linear active minutes/endurance drone SOC; no recharge

original_project.source_name: 西安地铁线网（导入数据）

model_assumptions.resources: One drone per vehicle; per-team spare stock; no cross-vehicle transfer
model_assumptions.road_proxy: Undirected railway shortest-distance proxy; no road dataset
model_assumptions.scope: Simulation only; no passenger timetables, real-time telemetry, operational dispatch or optimality claim
model_assumptions.service: All original stations allowed by explicit research-only assumption; virtual nodes never service
model_assumptions.sortie: Vehicle waits; drone returns to same original launch station; depot return reserved
model_assumptions.zero_swap_time: Configured zero swap duration represented by 1e-9 min for explicit SOC event

provenance_label: 本机新计算的仿真基线（研究模型）
